The author recapitulates data of déploiement relative to an ordered I: spaces, pair-indexed spaces and the two displayed maps labelled s_ij and b_ij. The local comma forms are retained exactly, including Sigma_{i,j} in the first source of data c and Sigma_{ij} in its second source. The first marginal note describes the structure mentioned in the Scholie, adds a continuous strictly increasing phi and says its restriction to Sigma_<x is injective, followed by the parenthetical assertion about the induced order. The inserted parenthetical question remains doubtful.

The author replaces the cancelled immersion by plongement and calls the map closed, then supplies the bracketed identification with a closed ss-espace of Sigma_j. The longer lower horizontal aligns with the next equality and is reproduced with that equality’s left and lower framing strokes; the right side remains open. The terminal Sigma_k is typeset as a doubtful glyph, with its low loop/retrace described here rather than redrawn as a newly identified symbol. The following locative insertion reads dans Sigma_jk :.

A local domain check was actually performed for the written inverse-image expression. Data c writes b_ij: Sigma_ij -> Sigma_j, and the bracket in a identifies its image with the subspace also written Sigma_ij inside Sigma_j. Thus the displayed inverse image is the set {u in Sigma_ij : b_ij(u) lies in that identified Sigma_ij}. Every element u of the displayed source has its image in that identified image subspace, so this set is all of the displayed source Sigma_ij. This follows directly from the map assignment and the identification written on this page. The author’s introductory phrase names Sigma_jk. The transcription retains b_ij^{-1}. Only the displayed map assignment and its written image identification are used in this local calculation.

The author calls (41) a commutative hexagonal diagram and places cart in each of its two right interior regions. The visual inventory contains seven nodes and nine edges, including five continuous source hooks. The overwritten lower-left capital remains a doubtful Sigma; its indices ij are clear. The concluding text calls the hook-marked arrows inclusions and says the other arrows will be fibrantes et propres in the equisingular case. These diagram and geometric assertions are reported as the author’s.

Every cancelled group is retained. The earlier fermé in condition a has a separate visible accent. Relatif à and inclusions are supported by the enlarged ink. The thin point and continuation details are local observations, not uniform substitutions across the manuscript.
